question:
**Select the most appropriate collocation to fill in the blank.**

Arun and his wife were _________ a baby boy after 18 years of their marriage.
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'blessed with.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the collocations given in the options:

 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 delighted with
 very pleased with something. (किसी चीज से बहुत प्रसन्न होना)
 
 

 prepared with
 made with something. (किसी चीज से बना हुआ)
 
 

 provided with
 to give someone something that they need. (किसी को वह चीज देना जो उसे चाहिए)
 
 

 blessed with
 to have something that you feel is special or lucky. (कुछ ऐसा होना जो आपको लगता है कि विशेष या भाग्यशाली है)
 
 

 
• The context of the sentence is that after 18 years of marriage, Arun and his wife were **lucky to have** a son.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "blessed with."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

 
• Another example:

 
 
• *Fortunately, we were **blessed with** fine weather.*
 
 

 

Complete Sentence:__ *Arun and his wife were __blessed with__ a baby boy after 18 years of their marriage.*
